scope: public crop/task priors only; SI units unless source_units is explicit

standard_harvest_ready_profiles.warning: published height SD/range contains large outliers; cap sampled aspect ratio rather than using raw maximum

density_reference.role: consistency/rejection gate; sample mass jointly with geometry rather than forcing one density

large_cluster_tomato_ood.recommended_role: OOD/robustness distribution until the deployed cultivar is known

exocarp_puncture_2mm_probe.role: damage/OOD constraint only; not a fingertip normal-force limit

whole_fruit_platen_compression.role: anisotropy/damage reference only; fixture geometry differs from fingertip contact

impact_energy_classes_j.role: OOD bruise-risk evaluation; not a universal hard damage threshold

tissue_mechanics_reference.role: future deformable-fruit model / damage proxy; never direct-map to rigid PhysX contact stiffness

xfem_exocarp_reference.role: model-specific light-red JinshengF1 fracture reference; sensitivity/OOD only

pure_axial_pull_off.recommended_sampler: linearly interpolate force mean/SD by sampled abscission diameter; sample a positive truncated normal; do not use an independent 4-8 N uniform as pure axial strength

three_point_bending.derivation: for the published center-load 3-point fixture, M_max = F*L/4

pedicel_cutting_shear_reference.warning: this is fixture shearing/cutting data on pedicel sections, not direct abscission-zone shear strength; do not use as Fs* without an explicit model assumption

manual_twist_assisted_detachment.warning: ratios combine S04 and S05 cultivars/tests; use as a medium-confidence Physics-v2 calibration target and report sensitivity

fatigue.required_treatment: fatigue exponent/onset/recovery are method hyperparameters; tune to public qualification targets and ablate rather than label as measured biology

greenhouse_peduncle_orientation.recommended_mapping: sample world-level quadrant category then sample continuous orientation inside the corresponding measured region if region bounds are reconstructed; if bounds are unavailable, use maximum-entropy within a declared quadrant and keep the local PPO grasp-frame invariant

human_grasp.source_geometry_note: 75% of pinch-picked fruit were <75 mm; all full-coverage examples were >90 mm; 167 semi-enclosed examples were 75-90 mm

public_contact_reference_not_hardware_ca.policy: rubber value is a sensitivity reference only; deployed G20 pad x cultivar/wetness friction remains HARDWARE_CALIBRATION_REQUIRED

recommended_physics_v2_method_defaults.evidence_role: ENGINEERING_HYPERPARAMETER constrained by public qualification targets

abscission_shear_ratio_prior.meaning: Fs*=ratio*Ft*; method assumption because S05 shear fixture is not AZ shear

recommended_physics_v2_method_defaults.twist_integrity_model: C <- C*exp(-k_theta*abs(dtheta_rad)*(abs(Mt)/Mt*)^q); scale Ft*, Fs*, Mb*, Mt* by remaining integrity C
recommended_physics_v2_method_defaults.twist_k_theta_derivation: -ln(11.66/44.781)/(2*pi), so a representative full-normalized-torque 360-deg twist leaves about 26.0% axial capacity; cross-study medium-confidence target
recommended_physics_v2_method_defaults.note: instantaneous/subcritical constants are research hyperparameters, not public biological measurements; include sensitivity/ablation

public_qualification_targets: pure axial: conditional mean/SD should reproduce S05 diameter nodes at 1 mm/s
three-point bending: center-load moment distribution should reproduce S05 12-mm-span groups/regression
pure torsion: torque and angle-to-detachment should remain inside S06 broad cultivar envelopes at 0.5-1.5 rad/s
twist-then-pull: after 360 deg, representative best-picking-state residual pull should target ~11.66 N mean and remain near/below 15.29 N observed maximum, acknowledging cross-cultivar uncertainty
behavioral: a 360-540 deg twist region must be feasible and should outperform pure axial pulling in peak grasp/load demand if the proposed mechanism is working
must_remain_hardware_calibrated: A7 controller response and command latency
G20 command/joint mapping, speed, latency, damping, friction and effort envelope
G20 fingertip-pad x target-tomato friction under actual dry/wet surface conditions
raw G20 tactile mapping if Newton-valued force is consumed
robot/hand mass, center of mass and inertia when vendor asset values are not trusted
known_public_data_gaps: no defensible continuous natural pedicel tilt distribution was found; only categorical greenhouse orientation evidence is frozen here
no direct abscission-zone shear failure distribution was found; pedicel cutting/shear tests must not be relabeled
no sufficiently matched numeric cyclic-fatigue law for the target tomato abscission zone was found; fatigue constants remain method hyperparameters
no public tomato-on-this-G20-pad friction or effective compliant-contact stiffness exists; these are pair-specific hardware measurements
